newsitem.title: UK: Willis says sterling rise may hit 1997.
newsitem.headline: Willis says sterling rise may hit 1997.

text.p: Willis Corroon Group Plc, the international insurance broker, announced a rise in 1996 profits on Thursday but warned that sustained sterling strength could affect 1997 figures.

"The recent rise in the value of sterling against major currencies, particularly the U.S. dollar, will, if sustained, affect group results adversely in terms of both the translation of U.S. dollar earnings and the realisation in sterling of dollar-denominated revenues," the company said in a statement. Pre-tax profits for the 12 months to December 31 rose to 91.6 million pounds, an increase of 83 percent over the same period last year which included 30 million pounds in exceptionals.
Sterling's recent rise had an adverse impact on 1996 profits of 3.1 million pounds.
